table.summaryDesc: Not everything is summarised the same way. Numbers that flow over time (inquiries, sessions, money) are added up. The "at month end" numbers are an average. And percentages are re-computed over the whole range — percentages can't simply be added.

metricsDesc.leadsClosed: All leads that left the pipeline — converted to clients or marked not relevant. (Versus "Converted to clients", which counts only those who became clients.)
metricsDesc.conversionRate: Of the inquiries that arrived this month, how many eventually became clients — even if that happened later. So a recent month's figure can still rise.
metricsDesc.activeClientsAtEnd: A snapshot on the last day of the month: how many clients were marked "active" at that moment. It is not a count of everyone you saw during the month.
metricsDesc.leftMidProcessPct: Of everyone who finished with you this month, the share who stopped part-way, before the programme ended.
metricsDesc.openTasksAtEnd: A snapshot on the last day of the month: how many tasks were still open. A task opened and closed within the same month never appears here.
metricsDesc.net: Income minus expenses. A negative number means more went out than came in.

trend.empty: Not enough data for a chart yet.
